name: Chicken Tikka Quiche with Leeks and Gruyère
description: A whole-wheat cumin shortcrust filled with spiced tikka chicken cubes, slow-cooked leeks, Gruyère and a hing-scented custard. Halal, no alcohol, Pakistani-French fusion.
keywords: chicken tikka quiche, halal quiche recipe, spiced chicken quiche, tikka quiche lorraine, Pakistani French fusion, whole wheat quiche
recipeIngredient: 2 medium leeks, trimmed and thinly sliced (approx. 250 g)

recipeInstructions.name: Marinate the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Combine all tikka marinade ingredients in a bowl. Add the chicken thighs, coat thoroughly, cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.

recipeInstructions.name: Make the pastry
recipeInstructions.text: Combine both flours, salt, cumin and coriander. Rub in cold butter until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs. Add ice-cold water one tablespoon at a time until the dough just comes together. Flatten into a disc, wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Grill the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Heat a grill pan over high heat until smoking. Cook the marinated thighs for 5–6 minutes per side until charred and cooked through (internal temperature 75°C / 167°F). Rest 5 minutes, then cut into 2 cm cubes.

recipeInstructions.name: Cook the leeks
recipeInstructions.text: Melt butter with oil in a saucepan over medium-low heat. Add leeks and salt. Cook uncovered for 18–20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until completely soft and pale golden. Cool on a plate.

recipeInstructions.name: Blind-bake the shell
recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Roll pastry to 3 mm and line a 23 cm loose-bottomed tart tin. Prick base, line with baking paper and baking beans. Blind-bake 15 minutes, remove beans and paper, bake a further 8 minutes. Reduce oven to 170°C (340°F).

recipeInstructions.name: Make the custard
recipeInstructions.text: Whisk together eggs, egg yolk, cream, milk, salt, white pepper and hing until smooth. Stir in parsley. Allow baked shell to cool 5 minutes before filling.

recipeInstructions.name: Assemble
recipeInstructions.text: Scatter leeks over the pastry base. Add tikka chicken cubes. Sprinkle three-quarters of the Gruyère over the top. Pour custard to within 3 mm of the rim. Scatter remaining Gruyère on the surface.

recipeInstructions.name: Bake
recipeInstructions.text: Place tart tin on a baking sheet and bake at 170°C (340°F) for 32–36 minutes until the custard is just set at the edges with a slight wobble at the centre (internal temperature 72°C / 162°F). Cool at least 15 minutes before unmoulding.
